lessons_used: Evidence is still thin for adoption (redesign), choose_path (copy, hint, layout), finish (layout), and sign_in (hint, notification, reorder) changes, as each has only 1 test so far.
home new_flow changes have 3 tests with positive noise-corrected gains and 1 winning test, showing this kind of change can be helpful.
finish new_screen changes have 2 tests agreeing that no clear effect was seen.
No clear effect was seen for most changes tested so far (9 out of 13 tests).
Predictions generally overestimated impact for most tests, but underestimated the size of major wins like sign_in notification and adoption redesign.

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Stage Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the adoption certificate screen into a theatrical stage layout with animated celebration and pet mascot presentation.
candidates.why: Adoption step drop-off is high (74.3% conversion, median 89s / mean 1017s) and support received multiple complaints about custom pet generation results.

adoption_certificate.headline: Welcome Your New Desktop Companion!
adoption_certificate.body: Your pet adoption certificate is official. Prepare your desktop workspace for their arrival.

guard.reason: The adoption certificate redesign removes the required official stamp.

candidates.title: Desktop Visibility Diagnostic Flow
candidates.change: Adds an automated desktop overlay diagnostic check during the waiting step to verify the pet will render properly on screen.
candidates.why: Support received 3 emails about pets failing to show up on the desktop after onboarding, and the home waiting room has a high mean duration (2336s).

waiting.hint: Checking graphics acceleration and desktop window permissions...

new_desktop_check.headline: Testing Desktop Display Permissions
new_desktop_check.body: We are making sure your pet can freely wander across your screens.

guard.reason: Adds a valid desktop check screen to onboarding flow without violating rules.

candidates.score_note: home new_flow changes have positive historical win rate and address long waiting times

candidates.title: Reorder Sign In After Pet Selection
candidates.change: Moves account sign-in step to occur right after pet selection so users establish ownership immediately after choosing their pet.
candidates.why: Support received 8 emails regarding missing or reset pets after signing back in, showing users lose track of account attachment during adoption.

sign_in.headline: Save Your Companion to Your Cloud Account
sign_in.body: Sign in now to lock in your pet selection across all your devices.

guard.reason: Creates urgency by telling the user to sign in now to lock in their selection.

candidates.title: Desktop Control Interactive Demonstration
candidates.change: Inserts a dedicated interactive controls preview screen right before completing onboarding to practice summoning and hiding the pet.
candidates.why: Support received 3 emails about confusion on how to control/hide/talk to the pet and 4 emails about misbehaving desktop features post-onboarding.

new_control_practice.headline: Try Out Your Desktop Controls
new_control_practice.body: Use quick shortcuts to summon, move, or minimize your pet at any time while working.

guard.reason: Adding an interactive control practice screen after home_intro is allowed inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Target step drops 35.2%, but finish new_screen tests consistently showed no clear effect

candidates.title: Sign In Pet Protection Copy Clarification
candidates.change: Updates sign-in headline and body copy to explicitly reassure users that existing cloud pets will sync automatically without losing progress.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or resetting after signing in again, making this the largest support theme.

sign_in.headline: Sync & Secure Your Desktop Pets
sign_in.body: Signing in ensures your pet settings, items, and custom models are permanently saved to your account across reinstalls.
sign_in.hint: Already have a pet on this account? It will be automatically restored.

guard.reason: Clarifies sign-in copy without touching pricing or losing screen functionality.

candidates.score_note: Addresses the largest support complaint theme with a simple copy update

candidates.title: Waiting Room Interactive Tip Carousel
candidates.change: Adds an interactive tip carousel to the waiting screen explaining pet habits and desktop interactions while background rendering runs.
candidates.why: The waiting room step takes a median of 201s and mean of 2336s, leading to drop-off before reaching home finish screen (64.8%).

components.text: Did you know? Double clicking your pet opens quick pet interactions.

guard.reason: Adds tip carousel to waiting screen while retaining the job of showing pet creation progress.

candidates.score_note: Addresses high waiting room duration in home step

candidates.title: Choose Path Grid Selection Layout
candidates.change: Reconfigures the path selection screen into a visual grid layout for faster path comparison.
candidates.why: Choose path takes a mean of 514s despite a fast 8s median, indicating extreme outlier hesitation for a key early funnel step.

choose_path.headline: Select Your Adoption Journey
choose_path.body: Pick how you would like to create or select your companion today.

guard.reason: Redesigns choose path layout while retaining options for both adopting and making your own pet.

candidates.score_note: choose_path layout change previously resulted in a -2.5% drop

candidates.title: Photo Upload Example Quality Hint
candidates.change: Adds explicit camera lighting and framing guidance text directly below the photo upload component.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failures or unexpected visual output.

upload_photos.hint: Use bright, evenly lit photos with your pet centered for the best 3D desktop model generation.

guard.reason: Adds quality guidance hint to photo upload screen without violating any base rules.

candidates.score_note: Hints on onboarding steps have historically underperformed

candidates.title: First Visit Badge Incentive
candidates.change: Adds a collectible 'Desktop Companion Pioneer' badge banner to the final home intro welcome screen.
candidates.why: The finish step has the highest drop-off rate in the funnel, converting only 64.8% of users who reach home intro.

home_intro.headline: Welcome to Your New Desktop Experience!
home_intro.body: You've unlocked the Pioneer Adoption Badge for completing setup.

guard.reason: Adds a pioneer badge to home_intro within onboarding without mentioning prices or gifts.

candidates.score_note: Targets finish step which suffers the highest drop-off in the funnel

candidates.title: Sign In Retry Alert Notification
candidates.change: Displays a timed status notification banner if sign-in response takes longer than 5 seconds.
candidates.why: Support logged 2 emails explicitly describing the sign-in screen stalling or failing to appear.

sign_in.hint: Connecting to sign-in servers... Click retry if screen does not load.

guard.reason: Adds sign-in status notification and timing within onboarding, which is explicitly permitted by Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: sign_in notification previously showed a +4.4% positive signal
